newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 1-yr state bond auction Sept 2.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 1-yr state bond auction Sept 2.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Tuesday it would conduct an auction of an unspecified tranche of Finance Ministry one-year state bonds on September 2.
The bonds will have a nominal value of 100,000 crowns ($2,880) and carry a fixed annual coupon of 11.00 percent.

The ministry earlier on Tuesday sold a 2.38 billion crown tranche of one-year bonds at an average accepted yield of 20.349 percent, up from 19.388 percent in the last auction of similar bonds on August 5.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer in state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main way to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.936 billion crowns for the first seven months of this year from 13.209 billion in the January-June period of 1997.
